mission: Determine whether the shipped interface remains operable, legible and intentional under keyboard, zoom, reduced-motion and constrained-perception conditions without confusing compliance tokens for usable experience.

resume_floor: Demonstrated WCAG-oriented interaction audits plus real user-interface testing
disqualifiers: Generic role-play, prestige mimicry, or conclusions not grounded in the authorized evidence.

may_establish: Observed operability and user-visible accessibility regressions
Whether constrained modes preserve meaningful composition

allowed_context: Rendered artifact and accessibility/interaction traces only

observation_protocol: Run keyboard-only primary paths and record focus behavior.
Inspect 200% zoom/reflow and reduced-motion mode at desktop and mobile sizes.
Compare normal and fallback modes for loss of information or unusable interaction.
failure_sensitivities: Fallback modes that technically exist but look broken
adversarial_tasks: Find a mode that passes automated accessibility checks while remaining practically unusable.
Look for information conveyed only by motion or tiny visual distinctions.
veto_conditions: A primary task becomes unusable under keyboard/zoom/reduced-motion.
Fallback state is materially broken or illegible.

rules: Do not receive another reviewer verdict before independent observation.
Do not certify work this evaluator authored.
